No allowlist restricts reads within the mounted workdir; the model retains `Read,Grep,Glob,Bash --permission-mode dontAsk` against the entire checkout. The `_ai_engine_claude_run_isolated` preflight (`scripts/ai_engine.sh:188–225`) only checks pool-overlap and path-validity, never file-scope.

The fallback code (75 → caller runs codex) does fire correctly, but the diagnostic reason it surfaces is the wrong label, so the documented-and-correct-reason requirement is only partially met (the `isolation_docker_missing`, `isolation_python_missing`, `isolation_support_missing`, `isolation_image_build_failed`, `isolation_mask_failed`, `isolation_relay_unavailable`, `isolation_pool_overlap`, `isolation_read_path_invalid`, `isolation_container_start_failed` paths are labelled distinctly; the session-dir path is not).

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:311 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The session-directory creation failure path still contains `isolation_mask_failed` instead of `isolation_session_dir_unavailable`.
  WHY: When session-directory creation fails, operators see `AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK reason=isolation_mask_failed` and are directed to investigate Git-config masking rather than session-directory availability.
- Requirement: "restrict model reads to non-secret audit inputs" — from issue #6236 recommendation: "Keep pool tokens outside the model process's filesystem and user identity; supply model authentication through a host-side relay and restrict model reads to non-secret audit inputs."
  Expected change site: scripts/ai_engine.sh::_ai_engine_claude_run_isolated, specifically the mount setup at line 301 and the container tool list at line 374
  Evidence of absence: Line 301 mounts the entire checkout readonly (`--mount "type=bind,src=${workdir},dst=${workdir},readonly`), giving the model unrestricted read access to every file in the checkout. The model runs with `--tools Read,Grep,Glob,Bash --permission-mode dontAsk` (line 374), so it can read any file in the mounted workdir — including `.env` files, config files with embedded credentials, `.git/hooks/`, and any other secret-bearing file. The git config masking at lines 267-305 only covers git config files; it does not restrict reads to the rest of the checkout. No allowlist mechanism, path filter, or read-scope restriction exists anywhere in the diff.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:311 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The session-directory creation failure path reports the fallback reason `isolation_mask_failed`, the same reason used for a genuine `_ai_engine_git_mask_configs` failure.
  WHY: A session-directory failure is unrelated to Git-config masking, so the emitted fallback directs operators to investigate the wrong subsystem; recovery is misrouted.
- Requirement: Issue #6236 recommendation — "Keep pool tokens outside the model process's filesystem and user identity; supply model authentication through a host-side relay and restrict model reads to non-secret audit inputs."
  Expected change site: scripts/ai_engine.sh::_ai_engine_claude_run_isolated, the mount setup at line 301 and the container tool list at line ~374 (`--tools Read,Grep,Glob,Bash --permission-mode dontAsk`).
  Evidence of absence: Line 301 bind-mounts the entire checkout read-only (`--mount "type=bind,src=${workdir},dst=${workdir},readonly"`). The Git-config masking at lines 202-272 only strips credential-bearing keys from `.git/config*` (http.extraheader, credential.*, remote.*.url/pushurl, url.*.insteadof, include/includeif). All other secret-bearing files that may live in the checkout — `.env`, `.npmrc`, `.netrc`, `.aws/credentials`, `.docker/config.json`, `~/.config/gh/hosts.yml`, arbitrary committed secrets — remain readable to the model via Read/Grep/Glob/Bash under `dontAsk`. No allowlist, path filter, or read-scope restriction exists anywhere in the diff. The PR closes the primary pool-token vector (host relay + placeholder token + pool excluded from mounts) and strips credential env vars + masks git config, but the third clause of the recommendation ("restrict model reads to non-secret audit inputs") is unfulfilled.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
